name: nextdoor-ads-mcp
description: Nextdoor Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented

platform_mcp_nextdoor_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEXTDOOR_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_nextdoor_api_token.description: Nextdoor Ads Manager API token (NAM > settings > API, https://ads.nextdoor.com/v2/manage/api) for an account granted Ads API access; one token per user, valid for one year, acting for every advertiser tied to the NAM account.

platform_mcp_nextdoor_advertiser_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NEXTDOOR_ADVERTISER_ID
platform_mcp_nextdoor_advertiser_id.description: Nextdoor advertiser id used by pause_resume (the status path is /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiserId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/status).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/v3/me: {profile {id, name, is_ad_agency}, user {id, email, advertisers_with_access [{id, role}]}}.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: The advertisers the token's user can reach, from GET /api/v3/me (user.advertisers_with_access: id and role only; names and currency come from GET /api/v3/advertisers/{id}).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiserId}/campaigns?pageSize= (archived excluded). `status` is the computed status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, NO_ACTIVE_AD_GROUPS, PAUSED_FOR_BILLING…; raw.data.user_status is the user setting) and is not a filter here. Budgets live on ad groups. Cursor paging: only the first page is returned.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiser_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/status {user_status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}; returns the updated campaign. Resuming restarts spending on its ad groups.
